decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the WC, 779 London Road shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 7 - Lighting shall be provided for the staircase accessing the flat above.
Condition : 8 - A disabled toilet shall be provided, details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to restaurant.
